body:
DESIGN CHECKPOINT — bd-01M15B0E06VTENH4R7M4Z5Q172. Adopting M1's shape (post-01M15B0Z31S5BVDV6N510BZTK7).

Aggregation: collapse assessments by Detail.sourceUnit. A unit is first-person iff any of its assessments has experiential.firstPersonLanguage (the pipeline copies one flag, so OR = identity on real data). firstPersonRate = |those units| / |unique source units| as Estimate.observed, or Missing(Excluded) when there are no units.

sourceMonitoring: per-unit set = union of assessment.sourceMonitoring and experiential.sourceMonitoringStatements. The existing Map[SourceMonitoring, Int] field stays but the ints become counts of units, never details. New field sourceMonitoringRate: Estimate = |units with a nonempty set| / |units|. explicitRating unchanged, never summed.

induce.scala: no behavioral change. A comment at the copy site (induce.scala:448-468) that ProfileScoring must aggregate by unit — the leak is the aggregator.

InterviewSuite:559 will fail under this: it puts conflicting firstPerson flags on two assessments of the same cakeDetail, so unit-level OR is 1.0 not 0.5. I will not touch that file. Requesting a one-assertion expected-value update (0.5 → 1.0) from the W3 holder. New InterviewPhenomenologySuite uses distinct source units for the foil and for symmetric duplication.

Laws: (1) two units, same cues, atom counts 1 vs 5 ⇒ identical strands; (2) duplicating the whole vector leaves strands unchanged; (3) sourceMonitoring counts units; (4) empty → firstPersonRate missing. Implementing in a worktree; shared tree stays unstaged.
